## Description

Sell a package (advance receipt), track sessions used/left with validity and status (Active, Expires soon, Completed). "Redeem 1 session today" books it against today's visit and adds a ₹0/AED 0 line on the invoice. Expired balances follow the refund policy from settings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Redemption decrements sessions atomically and cannot exceed the total.
- [ ] **AC2.** Expiry status updates daily; expiring-soon packages are listed for reception.
- [ ] **AC3.** Unused balance value is computed per the policy and shown.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
